'''命''' (life, destiny, command) is the symbol of [[Inochi-no-Michikyō]] (命道教). In sacred contexts 命 takes the place of 神, and its shrines are called 命神宮 (Myōjingū).

== Usage across concepts ==
; Life
: 命 ''inochi'', life itself; 生命 ''seimei'', life; 寿命 ''jumyō'', lifespan.
; Destiny
: 運命 ''unmei'' and 宿命 ''shukumei'', fate; 天命 ''tenmei'' (Chinese ''tiānmìng''), the Mandate of Heaven.
; Command
: 命令 ''meirei'', an order; 任命 ''ninmei'', appointment to an office.
; Naming
: 命名 ''meimei'', the giving of a name.
; Divinity
: ''mikoto'', the honorific borne by kami, as in 大国主命 Ōkuninushi-no-Mikoto.

== In Inochi-no-Michikyō ==
* 命 stands where other traditions write 神, so the word for a shrine is 命神宮 (Myōjingū).
* The name of the religion, 命道教, uses the reading ''inochi''.
* [[Inochi Daimyōjin no Mikoto]] uses the character three times, with three readings: ''inochi'', ''myō'' and ''mikoto''.
